exposure: Induction of labor method (vaginal dinoprostone vs mechanical methods)
outcome: Operative vaginal delivery for non-reassuring fetal status
cohort: Pregnancies complicated by late fetal growth restriction undergoing induction of labor
finding: The study found that mechanical methods for induction of labor were associated with a lower risk of uterine tachysystole, cesarean delivery, operative vaginal delivery for non-reassuring fetal status, and adverse neonatal outcomes compared to vaginal dinoprostone in pregnancies complicated by late fetal growth restriction.
